label: Root-zone soil moisture
description: Water content of the 10-200 cm soil layer. Drops during drought, recovers with rain; a slow decline signals drying.

label: Evapotranspiration
description: Surface latent heat flux, expressed as mm/day of water. Rises with heating; unlike a land-only product it includes the ocean.

label: Snow water equivalent
description: Water stored in the snowpack; a shrinking spring value signals earlier melt.
